item.title: $BTC miners are switching machines off. The hash rate sits 8% below last year's …
item.description: $BTC miners are switching machines off. The hash rate sits 8% below last year's level, the first annual decline since the 2021 China ban. That drop was forced by policy; this one is price-driven, with hash price at an all-time low.

item.title: The short term holder cost basis cluster has now turned into resistance. $BTC pu…
item.description: The short term holder cost basis cluster has now turned into resistance. $BTC pushed up into this block today and was rejected. These buyers are back near break-even, where many tend to sell. A close above $65K would show that demand can absorb their selling.

item.title: Altcoins led the market after news broke that Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang. Wi…
item.description: Altcoins led the market after news broke that Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang. Within 20 minutes, almost every top-50 coin was beating $BTC. The market reached for risk quickly: altcoins moved most, follower by the Nasdaq and Bitcoin, then the S&P 500.

item.title: $BTC bounced just above the whale cost basis. Whales holding 10k–100k BTC bought…
item.description: $BTC bounced just above the whale cost basis. Whales holding 10k–100k BTC bought here, almost exactly at the realized price. This region is strong support, and Saturday's low turned just above it. As long as price holds over this zone, the average holder stays in profit.

item.title: $BTC ETF volume has dried up. It is now below its median since launch, while out…
item.description: $BTC ETF volume has dried up. It is now below its median since launch, while outflows run near $260M per day. The last stretch this quiet, in mid-2024, came before the run to $100K. Periods of apathy tend to be better times to accumulate than periods of hype.

item.description: Crypto perps now trade billions before companies IPO. $ANT did 9.5B before its IPO and $SPCX 3.9B. OpenAI is already at 6.3B with no listing date set. $ANT and $SPCX traded most on Binance, then Hyperliquid. For OpenAI, Gate leads with 36%, ahead of Binance and Bitget.

item.title: The altcoin froth is gone. In late September, total spot volume was 4x Bitcoin's…
item.description: The altcoin froth is gone. In late September, total spot volume was 4x Bitcoin's. Today that ratio is below the summer lows. In risk-off markets, capital tends to consolidate into $BTC. In risk-on markets, this capital moves back into riskier assets.
